proposal.title: Restructure external product impacts — Cromemco 4FDC
proposal.reason: Consolidate descriptive content and move assessed product/standard effects into typed impact sections. Preserve historical interfaces, fictional-world boundaries and qualification limits. Evidence: data_storytelling/review_evidence/external-impact-revision/assessment.json.

before.name: Cromemco 4FDC
before.description: Cromemco 4FDC is a disk controller for S-100.

specification.description: Floppy controller supporting suitable 5¼- and 8-inch drives. The intended host environment is {host}. Interfaces, cabling and software must match that configuration.

Assessment at 1979-12-31. These are conditional commercial comparisons, not measured changes in sales.

{primary_offering}: A working native disk controller provides an alternative to buying a FlexiBUS host card for storage; both paths require host-specific qualification.

{related_offering}: On a suitably configured S-100 host, native disk storage is a competing purchase path. Capacity, boot support and disk formats must be compared separately; a controller alone is not a complete drive.

impacted_standards.assumption_description: Compare complete usable S-100 disk configurations, including the drive, controller, boot path and operating-system driver.
impacted_standards.comparison_description: Native controller registers and disk timing differ from FlexiBUS sector messages. Existing CP/M disk formats do not establish host-bus or media interchangeability.
impacted_standards.outcomes_description: Installed disks and BIOS support can hold users to native controllers. FlexiBUS offers a conditional cross-host reuse argument, subject to throughput and recovery qualification rather than assumed superiority.

specification.description: Floppy controller supporting suitable 5¼- and 8-inch drives. The intended host environment is {host}. Interfaces, cabling and software must match that configuration.

impacted_standards.assumption_description: Assess {historical_product} in its recorded {host} configuration. Compare complete usable S-100 disk configurations, including the drive, controller, boot path and operating-system driver.
impacted_standards.comparison_description: Native controller registers and disk timing differ from FlexiBUS sector messages. Existing CP/M disk formats do not establish host-bus or media interchangeability. The relationship concerns alternative complete configurations, not proven direct compatibility with this standard.
impacted_standards.outcomes_description: Installed disks and BIOS support can hold users to native controllers. FlexiBUS offers a conditional cross-host reuse argument, subject to throughput and recovery qualification rather than assumed superiority.

impacted_products.assumption_description: Assess the recorded {host} configuration with its required controller, cabling and software. Floppy controller supporting suitable 5¼- and 8-inch drives.
impacted_products.comparison_description: The alternative is a two-port S-100 FlexiBUS adapter. Existing-disk driver loading is its baseline; FlexiBUS boot needs a separately qualified ROM. It does not include a disk drive, serial modem or Disk II controller. The canonical implementation is {implementation}.
impacted_products.outcomes_description: A working native disk controller provides an alternative to buying a FlexiBUS host card for storage; both paths require host-specific qualification. This is a conditional purchase-path assessment, not evidence of measured market share or superior performance.

impacted_products.assumption_description: Assess the recorded {host} configuration with its required controller, cabling and software. Floppy controller supporting suitable 5¼- and 8-inch drives.
impacted_products.comparison_description: The alternative is a complete 5.25-inch drive with a FlexiBUS device controller. A native controller alone is not an equivalent complete purchase; compare the host adapter, drive, media format and boot/driver path together. The canonical implementation is {implementation}.
impacted_products.outcomes_description: On a suitably configured S-100 host, native disk storage is a competing purchase path. Capacity, boot support and disk formats must be compared separately; a controller alone is not a complete drive. This is a conditional purchase-path assessment, not evidence of measured market share or superior performance.
